property.name: ON_INVOKE
property.shortdesc: Dispatched when the ScriptMenuAction is invoked. This event does not bubble. This event is not cancelable.

property.name: BEFORE_DISPLAY
property.shortdesc: Dispatched before the ScriptMenuAction is displayed. This event does not bubble. This event is not cancelable.

property.name: BEFORE_INVOKE
property.shortdesc: Dispatched before the ScriptMenuAction is invoked. This event does not bubble. This event is cancelable.

property.name: AFTER_INVOKE
property.shortdesc: Dispatched after the ScriptMenuAction is invoked. This event does not bubble. This event is not cancelable.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the ScriptMenuAction.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the ScriptMenuAction (a Application).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the ScriptMenuAction within its containing object.

property.name: title
property.shortdesc: The name of the ScriptMenuAction for display in the user interface. The title includes any ampersand characters (&), which are used to tell the Windows OS to underline the following character in the name for use with the Alt key to navigate to a menu item. Double ampersands are used to display an actual ampersand character in the name. The Mac OS ignores and removes the extra ampersand characters.

property.name: enabled
property.shortdesc: If true, the ScriptMenuAction is enabled.

property.name: checked
property.shortdesc: If true, the menu item associated with the menu action is checked.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the ScriptMenuAction.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
